picks.why: Chubby, simple body matches the real card's chunky volume. Clean red nose with plain bands; 3 adds rivets on the nose and 1 is slimmer and sharper.
Fuller, tilted form with a glassy dome has the real card's toy weight and reads instantly. 2 is flatter, with a smaller dome and busier underside.
Simplest chest panel and compact, solid proportions. 1 has oversized sneaker feet; 3 adds a grille and a stray floor edge at the bottom.
Cleanest ray gun, with no invented parts, and diagonal stripes like the real card's background. 2 uses vertical stripes; 3 adds a green rear orb, green trigger and metal grip cap.
Thick rounded ring, glossy highlight and bold bands give the most solid volume. 2 and 3 have thinner rings, more stars and flatter, more illustrated shading.
Largest and boldest read, filling the frame like the real card, with a clear visor and simple gold ear cap. 1's ear is dull grey; 3 is smaller with an extra seam on top.
Fewest extras: a smooth shell with the dial built into a blue band. 1 adds vents and 2 adds riveted panels, so both look busier than the real cards.
Chunky, simple body with large windows and bold solar panels that fill the frame. 3 carries too much fine detail and a glowing ring; 1 is smaller, with a ring on its antenna.
Simple, chunky form with big readable controls and the fewest add-ons. 1 adds vents and extra LEDs; 3 adds a red side panel with vents.
True telescope proportions on a clean wooden tripod with no invented parts. 2 adds a brace between the legs; 1 has thin dark legs that look weak.
